name: Embryonaut
vision: Our own company, run the way we ask our clients to run theirs — Members holding the cap table, governing documents carried to execution, clients proposed to and contracted with, products carried from a vision statement to launch, and the accounting that keeps it all honest: invoices raised, payments recorded.

aggregates.name: Member
aggregates.description: A person who holds Units in the Company under the Operating Agreement — Chris, Angie, Meredith today. Email is this Member's own identity — see Email's own comment for why. role/identity_id are app access, granted separately from admission (GrantAccess, below): equity and app access happen to coincide for everyone here today, but the language doesn't conflate them.

invariants.description: a Percentage Interest is at least 0
a Percentage Interest is at most 100

commands.name: Admit
commands.goal: Bring a new Member onto the cap table

commands.name: Depart
commands.goal: Record that a Member has left — Units go to repurchase, not deletion

commands.name: GrantAccess
commands.goal: Let an existing Member sign in to this application

commands.name: LinkIdentity
commands.goal: Attach the real Identity a person's first Google sign-in minted

queries.name: ByIdentityId
queries.description: The Member row for a real, already-linked Identity.

aggregates.name: FoundingAgreement
aggregates.description: A governing document among the Members — the Operating Agreement, the IP Assignment Agreement, or the Hecks/Embryonaut Boundary — carried from draft to full execution.

commands.name: Draft
commands.goal: Put a governing document in writing, for attorney review

commands.name: Circulate
commands.goal: Send the draft to every Member for signature

commands.name: Execute
commands.goal: Record that every Member has signed

aggregates.name: Client
aggregates.description: A company or person we sell to. Churned rather than deleted — we forget nothing about who we've worked with.

commands.name: AddProspect
commands.goal: Bring a prospect into the pipeline

commands.name: Engage
commands.goal: Turn a prospect into a client we're actively working with

commands.name: Pause
commands.goal: Step back from a client without ending the relationship

commands.name: Reactivate
commands.goal: Pick a dormant relationship back up

commands.name: Churn
commands.goal: Mark the relationship over

queries.name: Prospects
queries.description: The pipeline — everyone not yet a working client.

queries.name: Active
queries.description: Clients we're actively working with today.

queries.name: Churned
queries.description: Former clients, kept for the record.

aggregates.name: Engagement
aggregates.description: The technical pipeline that earns a client's trust before a Proposal ever goes out — a story workshop, a domain written from it, a demo built on that domain.

commands.name: Schedule
commands.goal: Book a story workshop with a prospective client

commands.name: CompleteWorkshop
commands.goal: Record the use cases the story workshop surfaced

commands.name: DraftDomain
commands.goal: Write the client's business as a domain, from the workshop

commands.name: ShowDemo
commands.goal: Show the client an example app running on their own domain

queries.name: ReadyToPropose
queries.description: Demo shown — the pipeline's done its job, time to send a Proposal.

aggregates.name: Proposal
aggregates.description: A pitch to a client, before there's a Contract to sign — valid for a window, then it lapses.

invariants.description: a deliverable says what you get
an exclusion says what's out of scope
a currency is a three-letter code

commands.name: Draft
commands.goal: Put a proposed engagement in writing

commands.name: Send
commands.goal: Put the pitch in front of the client

commands.name: Accept
commands.goal: Record that the client wants to move forward

commands.name: Decline
commands.goal: Record that the client passed

commands.name: Expire
commands.goal: Let a proposal lapse past its validity window

aggregates.name: Contract
aggregates.description: An engagement with a client, from an accepted proposal to signature to delivery.

invariants.description: a currency is a three-letter code
a scope of work says what's being built
a revision is sequenced from one

commands.name: Draft
commands.goal: Turn an accepted proposal into a contract to sign

commands.name: Send
commands.goal: Put the draft in front of the client

commands.name: Sign
commands.goal: Record the client's signature

commands.name: Activate
commands.goal: Start delivering against a signed contract

commands.name: Complete
commands.goal: Close out a contract we delivered in full

commands.name: Terminate
commands.goal: End an engagement before it completed

commands.name: Revise
commands.goal: Log a change to the contract — the same revision history a real client folder tracks

queries.name: AwaitingSignature
queries.description: Sent, not yet signed — the follow-up list.

aggregates.name: Product
aggregates.description: Something we build to ship, carried from an idea through a vision statement to a launch.

commands.name: Conceive
commands.goal: Name a new product idea

commands.name: SetVision
commands.goal: Write down what this product is for, before a line of it is built

commands.name: BeginDevelopment
commands.goal: Start building against the vision

commands.name: Launch
commands.goal: Put it in front of clients

commands.name: Sunset
commands.goal: Retire a product we no longer carry

aggregates.name: Invoice
aggregates.description: A bill sent to a client against a contract.

invariants.description: an invoice has a due date
a currency is a three-letter code

commands.name: Draft
commands.goal: Prepare a bill for a client

commands.name: Send
commands.goal: Put the bill in front of the client

commands.name: MarkPaid
commands.goal: Record that the client paid in full

commands.name: MarkOverdue
commands.goal: Flag a bill that's gone past its due date unpaid

commands.name: Void
commands.goal: Cancel a bill that should never have gone out

queries.name: Outstanding
queries.description: Sent, not yet paid — the collections list.

aggregates.name: Payment
aggregates.description: Money a client sent against an invoice.

invariants.description: a currency is a three-letter code

commands.name: Record
commands.goal: Log money the client actually sent

commands.name: Refund
commands.goal: Give money back

aggregates.name: RecurringPayment
aggregates.description: A standing recurring charge against a contract — the monthly membership fee, still owed next cycle unless someone stops it.

invariants.description: a currency is a three-letter code

commands.name: Start
commands.goal: Set up a standing charge for the life of a contract

commands.name: AdvanceCycle
commands.goal: Move the schedule to the next cycle, once this one's been billed

givens.description: only an active recurring payment advances

commands.name: Pause
commands.goal: Stop billing without ending the arrangement

commands.name: Resume
commands.goal: Pick a paused charge back up

commands.name: Cancel
commands.goal: End the standing charge for good

queries.name: Active
queries.description: Charges still billing, soonest due first.
